body:
# Solitude
\sɔ.li.tyd\

Everything seems like a normal world, but something is off.
You notice that something is missing but can't quite pin down what it is.

A feeling of loneliness and dread sets in.

### Ultimate loneliness.

No monsters or animals will spawn, it is up to you to survive this barren and lifeless
landscape. This provides a unique challenge even for experienced players
as many items are only accessible using loot chests.

<details>
<summary>Features</summary>

- Prevent most entities from spawning
  - Notable exceptions: Items, End Crystals, Boats, Projectiles, Minecarts (and a few others)
- As a result from that, some other changes are necessary:
  - Blaze rods are now found in fortress chests & treasure bastions
    (No changes to ender pearls as they can be found in strongholds & trial chambers)
  - The End Fight is modified around there not being a dragon
- Multiplayer is mostly removed
  - You can still play on servers (independent of this mod) but all non-whitelisted entities 
  	will be invisible (including other players)
  - There is no access to Minecraft Realms.

</details>
